title: Beware of Finish
text: Beware of Finish. Hi, had this for 6 months and has been used less than 10 times. Works great but the out side finish (red)  is delicate and is already scratched down to bare metal in spots, disappointing for the price.

product_metadata.title: KitchenAid Aluminum Nonstick 6.0-Quart Chef's Pan with Lid Cookware - Empire Red
features: Dishwasher Durable with Nonstick Colorfast Finish
description: This Chef's Pan is an excellent multi-use pan for cooking everything from stir-fry to poached fish. The unique shape combines features of a Saute Pan and wok. The domed tempered glass lid seals in moisture and lets you monitor your cooking at a glance. And our durable 3-layer interior coating ensures long-lasting nonstick performance.
